title: Newspaper Article Mysterious Arrest Of Young Briton

THE SHANGHAI TIMES 3$5.35
14797
D

MYSTERIOUS ARREST
OF YOUNG BRITON

Earl of Rosse's Heir Held
by Chinese in Kansu

"TRUMPED-UP CHARGE
OF PETTY THEFT"

Peiping, May 2.
The Hon. Desmond Edward Parsons,
brother of the Earl of Rosse, who has
been arrested by the Chinese authori-
ties in Kansu, telegraphs that he is
being detained at Ansichow, in the
far northwestern corner of the prov-
ince, on a "trumped-up charge of
petty theft." His requests for per-
mission to leave the town have been
refused.
The British Legation has asked the
National Government to telegraph the
Kansu authorities to allow Mr. Par-
sons to leave Kansu for Peiping
immediately.
Mr. Parsons, who has lived in
Peiping for some time, recently went
on a journey into the northwest of
China. He was arrested at Tunhuang,
whence he was removed to Ansichow.
--Reuter.
(The Earl of Rosse, whose seat is
at Birr Castle, King's County, Ireland,
is one of the largest landowners in
the peerage, his estates covering
26,500 acres. The Hon. Desmond
Parsons, who was born in December,
1910, is the Earl's only brother and
is heir presumptive to the title.)

Nanking Officially Unaware
Nanking, May 2.
No official information has been
received by the Foreign Office con-
cerning the arrest of Mr. Parsons,
it was announced here this afternoon,
and it was also stated that no re-
presentations had been received from
the British authorities.
The reported arrest of Mr. Parsons
is being investigated by the Foreign
Office.--Reuter.

英国青年神秘被捕

罗斯伯爵继承人被甘肃中方扣押

“捏造的小偷小摸罪名”

北平，5月2日。
罗斯伯爵之弟、德斯蒙德·爱德华·帕森斯阁下（The Hon. Desmond Edward Parsons）在甘肃被中国当局逮捕，他发电报称，自己正以“捏造的小偷小摸罪名”被拘禁于该省西北角的安西州（Ansichow）。他获准离开该镇的请求已被拒绝。
英国公使馆已要求国民政府电告甘肃当局，允许帕森斯先生立即离开甘肃前往北平。
帕森斯先生已在北平居住一段时间，最近前往中国西北旅行。他在敦煌被捕，随后被转移至安西州。——路透社。
（罗斯伯爵的宅邸位于爱尔兰国王郡（King's County）的比尔城堡（Birr Castle），是贵族中最大的地主之一，其地产面积达26,500英亩。德斯蒙德·帕森斯阁下生于1910年12月，是伯爵唯一的弟弟，也是爵位的推定继承人。）

南京方面官方表示不知情
南京，5月2日。
今天下午在此间宣布，外交部尚未收到有关帕森斯先生被捕的任何官方消息，并称也未收到英国当局的任何交涉照会。
外交部正在调查有关帕森斯先生被捕的报道。——路透社。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. R. SECTION.
No. D 6699
Date 3 / 5 / 35

REUTERS PACIFIC SERVICE
RPS:1
Briton Arrested In Kansu
- - -
Heir To Earl Of Rosse
- - -
Investigation Requested

PEIPING, May 2.

News reached Peiping to-day of the arrest
by the Chinese authorities at Lanchow, Kansu, of Desmond
Edward Parsons, brother and heir of the Earl of Rosse,
one of the largest land-owners in England.

The charges against Mr. Parsons, a young
man of 24, are not known.

It is understood that the British authorities
have requested the Foreign Office at Nanking to investigate
the affair and to ask for his release. This is now being
done.

Mr. Parsons, who has been a resident of Peiping
for some time, recently went on a journey into the north-
west of China.-REUTERS PACIFIC SERVICE.

日期 1935年5月3日

路透社太平洋分社
RPS:1
英国人在甘肃被捕
- - -
罗斯伯爵继承人
- - -
请求调查

北平，5月2日。

今日北平获悉消息，英国最大地主之一罗斯伯爵的弟弟兼继承人德斯蒙德·帕森斯（Desmond Parsons）在甘肃兰州被中国当局逮捕。

针对这位24岁青年的指控内容尚不清楚。

据悉，英国当局已请求南京外交部调查此事并要求释放他。目前正在进行中。

帕森斯先生已在北平居住一段时间，最近前往中国西北旅行。——路透社太平洋分社。

1935年5月2日
